mythology: When Lord Shiva performed the cosmic dance of destruction carrying Sati's body, Vishnu's Sudarshana Chakra fragmented her form; her Yoni (creative organ) fell on the Nilachala hill, turning the soil red and sanctifying it as the supreme Tantric Mahapitha.
festivals: Ambubachi Mela (annual fertility and monsoon festival)
pilgrimage_significance: Center of the Kaula and Tantric Shakta traditions, venerated as the core Mahapitha where the creative cosmic womb of Mother Earth is worshipped without any anthropomorphic idol.
historical_notes: Mentioned extensively in the Kalika Purana and Yogini Tantra; ancient seat of Kamarupa kingdom where Tantric lineages, astrology, and indigenous traditions converged.
